title: Allocator-war residual institutional obligation adjudication Wave 37

residual_obligations.completion_test: All implementing offices, delegations, versions, exceptions, overrides, recusals, dissent, and dispositions are source-addressed.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Complete internal implementing-office files, delegations, exceptions, overrides, recusals, dissent, and dispositions remain unobserved.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Published Federal Register metadata is not an internal implementation file.

residual_obligations.target_row: complete agency submission and inventory roster
residual_obligations.completion_test: Every required agency submission, non-submission, correction, and no-action row is preserved.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: A complete agency-by-agency submission, correction, non-submission, and no-action roster remains unobserved.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: A public workforce dataset is not an agency inventory submission.

residual_obligations.completion_test: Attributed office, author, reviewer, approver, effective date, supersession, and withdrawal are preserved.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Public instruments and guidance do not supply a complete author-review-approval-supersession chronology.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: A named agency or office is not personal motive, authorship, or coordination.

residual_obligations.completion_test: Observed implementation, exception, challenge, correction, and no-action outcomes are joined to the exact instrument version.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Named implementation and disposition records do not supply every instrument-version consequence, exception, challenge, correction, and no-action row.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Publication of an instrument is not observed implementation or practical correction.

residual_obligations.completion_test: All contracts, assistance awards, modifications, terminations, and no-action rows under the contested condition are enumerated.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: The source set does not enumerate every covered contract, assistance award, modification, termination, and no-action row under one exact condition.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: USAspending aggregate counts or Grants.gov opportunities are not the covered-instrument universe.

residual_obligations.completion_test: Every certification, records request, referral, review, exception, sanction, declination, appeal, and no-action row is preserved.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: The source set does not enumerate every certification, records request, referral, review, exception, sanction, declination, appeal, and no-action row.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Award receipt is not certification, violation, liability, or enforcement.

residual_obligations.completion_test: Recipient, parent, contractor, subcontractor, awardee, and successor identities are resolved with effective dates.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Recipient names and public award identifiers do not resolve every parent, contractor, subcontractor, awardee, and successor identity.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Name similarity or shared programme participation is not legal-entity identity or relationship.

residual_obligations.completion_test: Condition-specific action, burden, correction, closeout, continuity, substitution, and no-effect rows are linked to the exact instrument.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Announcements and named settlements do not supply a complete post-award consequence, correction, closeout, continuity, substitution, and no-effect history.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: An opportunity or award announcement is not a post-award outcome.

residual_obligations.completion_test: All referrals, complaints, certifications, records requests, routed matters, rejections, and no-action rows are enumerated.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Public announcements do not expose a complete referral, complaint, certification, records-request, routed-matter, rejection, and no-action register.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: A public reporting channel or initiative announcement is not the referral denominator.

residual_obligations.completion_test: All investigations, settlements, litigations, withdrawals, declinations, sanctions, and no-action rows are source-addressed.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Named investigations and dispositions do not expose the complete investigation, litigation, settlement, withdrawal, declination, sanction, and no-action register.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Press releases are not a complete enforcement register.

residual_obligations.completion_test: The complete covered population, excluded population, and sector scope are preserved with effective dates.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: The exact covered and excluded entity and sector denominator remains incomplete.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: One named resolution or selected publication list is not prevalence or coverage.

residual_obligations.target_row: appeal, correction, and final disposition ledger
residual_obligations.completion_test: Challenges, appeals, remands, modifications, compliance, recurrence, and finality are preserved.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Named dispositions do not supply every appeal, remand, modification, compliance, recurrence, and finality row.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Settlement or investigation is not admission or final merits success unless the instrument states it.

residual_obligations.target_row: staffing, budget, timing, and recurrence denominator
residual_obligations.completion_test: Institutional capacity, timing, repeat actions, and no-action intervals are preserved without converting recurrence into coordination.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Public records do not supply a complete staffing, budget, timing, repeat-action, and no-action-interval denominator.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Repeated publication does not establish prevalence, common purpose, or coordination.

residual_obligations.completion_test: All filings, pleadings, sealed or restricted entries, dismissals, settlements, abandoned paths, and final dispositions are preserved.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Public dockets and published decisions do not include every sealed, restricted, abandoned, dismissed, settled, and final entry.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: A published decision index is not the complete docket.

residual_obligations.completion_test: The exact decision, instrument, evidence, criteria, and administrative record under review are joined to the docket.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: The complete challenged-action and administrative record remains unavailable for every docket.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: A docket number alone does not identify the complete challenged action.

residual_obligations.target_row: final correction, compliance, and durability record
residual_obligations.completion_test: Remand implementation, payment, reinstatement, reevaluation, recurrence, and durability are observed.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Formal decisions and settlements do not establish complete practical correction, payment, reinstatement, reevaluation, recurrence, and durability.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Formal remand, dismissal, or settlement is not practical correction.

residual_obligations.target_row: access, cost, timing, and abandonment denominator
residual_obligations.completion_test: Filing access, representation, fees, delays, abandonment, and unavailable routes are measured across the eligible universe.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Public route documentation does not measure representation, fees, delay, abandonment, and unavailable routes across the eligible universe.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Existence of a formal route is not effective counterpower.

residual_obligations.completion_test: Comparable denied, dismissed, withdrawn, unfiled, and no-correction rows are preserved.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Published cases do not supply the matched denied, dismissed, withdrawn, unfiled, and no-correction control universe.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Published successful cases are not the correction denominator.

residual_obligations.completion_test: A privacy-safe aggregate or authorized person-level roster includes promotion, tenure, retention, discipline, reassignment, separation, and no-action rows.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Protected personnel decision rows require lawful privacy-safe or authorized access.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Public workforce aggregates are not protected personnel decisions.

residual_obligations.completion_test: Eligible comparators, decision criteria, stated reasons, exceptions, overrides, and decision custody are preserved under lawful access.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Protected comparator, reason, exception, override, and decision-custody rows require lawful privacy-safe or authorized access.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Public category membership or aggregate movement is not an individual comparator or reason.

residual_obligations.target_row: lawful appeal, correction, and outcome ledger
residual_obligations.completion_test: Grievance, MSPB, EEOC, FSGB, union, court, settlement, remedy, timing, and no-correction rows are preserved.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Protected grievance, appeal, remedy, timing, and no-correction rows require lawful privacy-safe or authorized access.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: A published case report is not the complete protected correction denominator.

residual_obligations.completion_test: A source-explicit rule identifies every included, excluded, burdened, corrected, and no-effect person or entity row.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Public rules and named actions do not identify every included, excluded, burdened, corrected, and no-effect person or entity row.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Formal categories are not observed affected rows.

residual_obligations.completion_test: Eligible unaffected, unselected, untreated, and alternative-path rows are preserved under the same time and scope rules.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Eligible unaffected, unselected, untreated, and alternative-path populations remain incomplete under common scope and time rules.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Named litigants, awardees, or recipients are not the comparator population.

residual_obligations.completion_test: Join keys, effective dates, parent and successor rules, ambiguity holds, and refusals are explicit.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Shared names, programme presence, and public award identifiers do not complete lawful cross-system entity resolution.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Name matching, shared programme presence, or repeated source appearance is not identity or relationship.

residual_obligations.target_row: burden, no-effect, recurrence, and substitution outcomes
residual_obligations.completion_test: Outcome windows include burden, no observed effect, recurrence, reversal, substitution, exit, and durability rows.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: The complete burden, no-effect, recurrence, reversal, substitution, exit, and durability outcome ledger remains incomplete.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: An aggregate base universe is not a distributional outcome ledger.

residual_obligations.completion_test: Group definitions, eligibility, denominators, missingness, lawful privacy treatment, and correction routes are preserved.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Group definitions, denominators, missingness, privacy treatment, and correction routes remain incomplete across the affected universe.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Unequal observed outcomes alone do not establish motive, racial order, prevalence, coordination, or common purpose.

residual_obligations.completion_test: Obligations, outlays, settlement amounts, payment dates, receivables, offsets, and nonpayment rows are preserved.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Announced amounts and bounded award rows do not establish complete obligations, outlays, payment dates, receivables, offsets, and nonpayment.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Announced value is not realized payment or recovery.

residual_obligations.target_row: complete clawback, repayment, loss, and no-recovery ledger
residual_obligations.completion_test: Clawbacks, repayments, write-offs, defaults, losses, waivers, and no-recovery rows are enumerated.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Named settlements, audit/public records, and award counts do not enumerate every clawback, repayment, write-off, default, loss, waiver, and no-recovery row.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: An audit finding is not a realized recovery.

residual_obligations.completion_test: Replacement providers, transition costs, service continuity, exit, interruption, and no-substitution rows are preserved.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Announcements and protest records do not establish complete replacement-provider, transition-cost, interruption, exit, and no-substitution rows.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Programme termination is not successful substitution or continuity.

residual_obligations.completion_test: Corrective plans, milestones, verification, recurrence, performance, and durability are observed.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Plans, settlements, and recommendations do not establish complete milestone completion, independent verification, recurrence, performance, and durability.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: A corrective-action plan is not completed correction.

residual_obligations.completion_test: Public contribution, private residual rights, data, IP, operating knowledge, enterprise value, and public recovery terms are explicit.
residual_obligations.completion_gap: Public support and selected awards do not expose complete public contribution, private residual rights, data, IP, operating knowledge, enterprise value, and recovery terms.
residual_obligations.refused_substitution: Public support or private gain alone does not establish extraction, favoritism, or common purpose.
